note: Public guides agree on most limits. TikTok and Pinterest guides disagree, so Buddy uses the smaller number. These are format rules, not a trained model.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.shape: Feed photo, carousel, or Reel. The caption folds near 125 characters.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.shape: Feed post. The hard cap is 63,206. Buddy keeps the draft short.

platforms.name: Threads
platforms.shape: Text post. A longer note can be attached, but this draft stays in the post.

platforms.name: WhatsApp
platforms.shape: Status text. A media caption can be longer. This draft is the status.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.shape: Short video or photo post. Guides also cite 4,000, so Buddy stays at 2,200.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.shape: A title under 100 characters and a description under 5,000.

platforms.name: X
platforms.shape: A free-account post. A link counts as 23 characters. Premium posts can be longer. Buddy writes for the free limit.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.shape: Feed post. The first lines show before See more.

platforms.name: Pinterest
platforms.shape: Pin title and description. Guides also cite 800, so Buddy stays at 500.

platforms.name: Bluesky
platforms.shape: Short post. Images and video are not mixed in one post.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.shape: A title and a short body. You still choose the community.

platforms.name: Snapchat
platforms.shape: A short caption on a Snap. Public guides disagree, so Buddy stays under 160.
